2608.11713.title: High-dimensional Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Learned Variable Interactions
2608.11713.paper_summary: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is effective in identifying the Pareto fronts for expensive black-box problems. However, most current MOBO approaches are limited to low-dimensional decision space due to its exponential sampling complexity. This paper presents decision variable interaction analysis-based MOBO, ViaMOBO, a generic framework for expensive multi-objective problems with high-dimensional decision space. The key idea of ViaMOBO is that it utilizes a variable interaction analysis model to determine whether the decision space can be completely or partially divided, and then performs local Bayesian optimization in the divided decision subspaces. Through the variable analysis model, it can be derived whether the objectives in black-box problems are separable, partially separable, or non-separable based on the potential independent or interdependent relationships among decision variables without any strong assumptions. We compare ViaMOBO with the state-of-the-art MOBO methods on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks. The experimental results demonstrate that ViaMOBO outperforms other related MOBO baselines in approximating the Pareto front of high-dimensional expensive multi-objective problems.
2608.11713.paper_summary_zh: 多目標貝葉斯優化（MOBO）在識別昂貴黑箱問題的帕累托前沿方面是有效的。<lb/>然而，目前大多數MOBO方法因其指數級的取樣複雜性而僅限於低維決策空間。<lb/>本文提出了一種基於決策變數互動分析的MOBO，即ViaMOBO，這是一個針對高維決策空間的昂貴多目標問題的通用框架。<lb/>ViaMOBO的關鍵思想是利用變數互動分析模型來確定決策空間是否可以完全或部分劃分，然後在劃分的決策子空間中執行局部貝葉斯優化。<lb/>通過變數分析模型，可以推導出黑箱問題中的目標是否可分、部分可分或不可分，這是基於決策變數之間潛在的獨立或相互依賴關係，而無需任何強假設。<lb/>我們將ViaMOBO與最先進的MOBO方法在合成和現實世界基準上進行比較。<lb/>實驗結果表明，ViaMOBO在逼近高維昂貴多目標問題的帕累托前沿方面優於其他相關的MOBO基準。
